skill.description: Repository: https://github.com/atomicreps/cli npm: atomicreps (run with `npx -y atomicreps mcp`) Website: https://atomicreps.com/coding-agent Retrieval practice for developers who code with an agent. When a task finishes, the agent calls `rep` with a few words for what changed, and the server returns one short multiple-choice question about that topic, or nothing. The server sets the pace (a minimum gap, a daily cap, mutes, off) and never sends the answer key. Works in Claude Code, Cursor, GitHu
